set -eu
[ "$(id -un)" = robot ] || exit 21
[ "$(readlink -f -- /data/robot/p001)" = /data/robot/p001 ] || exit 22
[ ! -L /data/robot/p001 ] || exit 23
cd -P /data/robot/p001
/data/robot/p001/env/bin/python -I -B - <<'PY'
import datetime, json, os, pwd, shutil, subprocess, sys
root = "/data/robot/p001"
assert pwd.getpwuid(os.geteuid()).pw_name == "robot"
assert os.path.realpath(root) == root
assert os.path.isdir(root)
real_exe = os.path.realpath(sys.executable)
assert os.path.commonpath((root, real_exe)) == root
usage = subprocess.run(["du", "-sb", "-x", "--", root], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, timeout=45)
project_bytes = int(usage.stdout.split()[0])
vfs = os.statvfs(root)
result = {
 "kind": "READ_ONLY_OPERATIONAL_PREPARATION",
 "measured_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 "account": pwd.getpwuid(os.geteuid()).pw_name,
 "uid": os.geteuid(),
 "project_requested": root, "project_resolved": os.path.realpath(root),
 "project_bytes_apparent_one_filesystem": project_bytes,
 "project_cap_bytes": 100000000000,
 "project_headroom_bytes": 100000000000-project_bytes,
 "filesystem_total_bytes": vfs.f_blocks*vfs.f_frsize,
 "filesystem_available_bytes": vfs.f_bavail*vfs.f_frsize,
 "filesystem_total_inodes": vfs.f_files,
 "filesystem_available_inodes": vfs.f_favail,
 "inode_reporting": "AVAILABLE" if vfs.f_files > 0 else "FILESYSTEM_DOES_NOT_REPORT_INODES",
 "quota_utility_available": shutil.which("quota") is not None,
 "interpreter": {"requested": sys.executable, "resolved": real_exe, "version": sys.version.splitlines()[0], "prefix": sys.prefix, "isolated": sys.flags.isolated, "dont_write_bytecode": sys.dont_write_bytecode},
 "new_e163_artifact_allowance_bytes": 268435456,
 "scientific_admission": "PENDING_FREEZE_SOURCE_AND_INPUT_HASHES_PEAK_ESTIMATE_AND_EXECUTION_STATE",
 "remote_files_created_by_query": 0, "real_fits": 0, "prefix_deserializations": 0, "metering_prechecks": 0, "campaign_started": False
}
print("E163_READ_ONLY_JSON_BEGIN")
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
print("E163_READ_ONLY_JSON_END")
PY
exit
